explanation: Constructed analytically from unedited activations across plain questions, correct and wrong guesses, uncertainty-only controls, multiple guess phrasings, and word/numeric answer positions. Guess-related shifts become shared across phrasings before layer 11 global attention, whereas later correct/wrong differences are answer-specific. The rank-8 adapter targets only layer 10 o_proj and down_proj, partially suppressing normalized pre-retrieval guess shifts with a covariance-metric oblique projection. Protected control means, within-condition factual variation, post-RMSNorm scale compensation, fixed shrinkage, and a shared weight-norm cap limit collateral changes. No gradients, optimizers, iterative loss fitting, or edited-model evaluations were used.
